meaning:
τάχα
(ταχύς),
adv., [in LXX: Wis.13:6 14:19 * ;]
(a) (chiefly poët.), quickly, presently;
(b) perhaps: Rom.5:7, Phm 15.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a righteous person someone would even dare to die.
For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while, that you would have him forever,
